notes.title: Cubecois game update
notes.content:
We listen to our customers! Cubecois has been updated with the following:

1. No more "Pay to Win". All customers will receive the power ups!

2. The game is now easier during the first stages of the game. Obstacles have been reduced and borders have been added on the platform/road. Players now bounce back on the road when they hit the borders (instead of crashing). 

3. The music has been updated.

4. Players can now turn off the music.

5. A new default (free) skin has been added.

We hope you enjoy the game,

The 9Squad team!
